source_measure: Frozen root-conversation assistant elapsed time; not human labor or TiMaS time.

source_prefix.cutoff_reason: Latest completed whole-game README turn before the current report revision; current turn 167 and all later activity excluded.

method.unit: One ended root assistant turn, paired by turn_id with recorded duration_ms; no within-turn minute splitting.
method.classification: Actual requests and assistant outcomes were reviewed by the auditor. Short replies inherit the current work package. Ambiguous outcomes were checked against the frozen source. Classification is semantic rather than keyword-based.
method.primary_package_rule: Choose the package that the turn primarily delivers. A selected implementation keeps its associated tests; an open candidate-comparison campaign keeps experimental coding, fixtures, repeats, analysis and reviews.
method.mixed_rule: Retain turns24,61,81,103,165 as inseparable multi-purpose work. Retain interrupted turn40 as unattributed because no assistant response/tool call is recorded.
method.stage_axis: Reuse the reviewed primary-context stage assignment exactly, retaining shared and the Stage1/Stage2 mixed row; this audit does not change stage totals.
method.time_inclusions: Model processing, tools, tests, waits and child-agent coordination are included. Child sessions are never summed again. Gaps between root turns are excluded.
method.source_cutoff: Keep the original turn166 cutoff; all later report revision, rejection discussion and this audit are excluded.
method.game_completion_split: Turns1..159 through verified game completion; turns160..166 are later Stage3 reporting and shared delivery. No new tracker or server action was taken.
method.semantic_review_status: Second semantic pass checked primary-versus-associated work and all mixed cases. One preliminary request-only assignment was corrected: interrupted turn40 moved from comparison to unattributed. This is one auditor classification, not a claim of two independent purpose coders.

purpose_definitions.label: Requirements, design and review
purpose_definitions.definition: Requirements, rule/model clarification, mathematical reasoning, architecture, technical review and experiment planning not led by an executed candidate comparison. Small illustrative checks may support the reasoning.
purpose_definitions.not_claimed: Pure coding or pure model-thinking time.

purpose_definitions.label: Implementation-led packages
purpose_definitions.definition: Implement a selected feature or correction. Includes its code reading, local diagnosis, associated tests, reviews and before/after acceptance measurements in the same turn.
purpose_definitions.not_claimed: A stopwatch of typing code; associated tests cannot be subtracted.

purpose_definitions.label: Candidate comparison-led packages
purpose_definitions.definition: Select or evaluate alternatives: build experimental modes/fixtures, run controlled comparisons or sweeps, analyze results and plan/interpret follow-up comparisons. Includes rejected candidates and repeated runs.
purpose_definitions.not_claimed: Pure benchmark CPU or elapsed machine execution; experimental coding and review are embedded.

purpose_definitions.label: Standalone validation and coverage
purpose_definitions.definition: Standalone coverage audits, fixture/regression additions and frozen-solver validation campaigns. Includes planning/explaining holdouts, generating data, checking plans and writing results.
purpose_definitions.not_claimed: All testing in the project or only time executing tests; other purposes also contain tests.

purpose_definitions.label: Investigation and diagnosis
purpose_definitions.definition: Reproduce or explain a failure, inspect traces/profiles/configuration provenance, and use diagnostic controls before a general improvement is selected.
purpose_definitions.not_claimed: Every diagnostic test or correction is separately timed.

purpose_definitions.label: Live operations and recovery
purpose_definitions.definition: Create/solve/submit/reconcile real tasks, run progression, recover expired tasks or investigate the state of a stopped live run. Small integration fixes and local checks can be embedded.
purpose_definitions.not_claimed: Only server processing time or only network waiting.

purpose_definitions.label: Documentation and delivery
purpose_definitions.definition: Produce reports, README and delivery-plan artifacts, derive presentation evidence, and refresh documentation/package outputs; associated verification may be embedded.

purpose_definitions.label: Environment, workflow and tracker
purpose_definitions.definition: Starter extraction, workflow installation/activation, or standalone tracker/desktop-control actions.
purpose_definitions.not_claimed: All workflow overhead, since some remains embedded in other turns.

purpose_definitions.label: Mixed or unattributed
purpose_definitions.definition: Independent work purposes cannot be split from the recorded interval, or an interrupted turn has no observable response allowing its purpose to be established.
purpose_definitions.not_claimed: A fabricated proportional allocation to coding, testing or experiments.

game_completion_boundary.meaning: The recorded turn confirms all three stages complete; its whole interval remains in the through-completion package total.

comparison_plus_standalone_validation_pa.meaning: Time in comparison-led and standalone-coverage-led whole-turn packages; not pure testing execution. All these assigned turns occur before game completion. Additional tests/comparisons are embedded in implementation and mixed packages and are not extracted.

design_implementation_diagnosis_packages.meaning: A presentation roll-up of design/review, selected implementation and diagnosis packages; not pure coding and not a measured no-testing completion time.
